description: Lists the workspace's allowlist: addresses mail may go to despite a suppression, each with its attestation. With `view: suppressed` it lists instead which of the workspace's recent recipients are suppressed, and why (up to 500).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's `next_cursor`.

view.description: `suppressed`: list which of your own recent recipients are suppressed for you, and why, instead of the allowlist.

name: mails_suppressions_list
title: List the suppression allowlist
